remarks: Welcome to Currier Court. An exciting opportunity is here to come and see a stylish two bedroom end unit ranch townhouse with a finished lower level and, believe it or not, an attached two car garage. This sparkling, bright corner ranch has brand new windows throughout, freshly painted, skylights, pocket doors, and ready to move in. It offers a cathedral ceiling living room with lots of windows, a family room adjoining the skylit kitchen with lots of built-ins and a fireplace. There are two bedrooms and two baths, one with skylights, and laundry all on the main level. On the lower level there is a nice large bonus room with new floors and three small windows bringing in natural light, a full bath and a wet bar, a good sized storage room which could be a potential office. There is also a large 2 car garage with two entrances to the lower level. A private garden is off the family room. This unit was originally the builder's model unit so there are extra custom features. One can walk to town, the train and all that the village of New Canaan has to offer.  Excellent value and priced to sell.  Run...do not walk!!
